name: Create a contact list
description: Create a static list of contacts inside a folder. Use for fixed audiences; for rule-based audiences use segments.create_segment.

folder_id.description: Folder id. The default folder on a new account was 1.

folder_name.description: The folder's internal name, which can differ from the name shown in the UI (folder 1 is shown as 'Your First Folder' but sent as 'Client_Folder').

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Executed through the UI with request capture. Created 'Catalogo teste lista' (id 5). Whether folder_name is required was not tested.

alternative_executions.auth: API key in the api-key header. Not included here.
